description: Feuerwehrgerätehäuser Landkreis Mittelsachsen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.landkreis-mittelsachsen.de. Locations of the firefighting equipment houses of the district of Mittelsachsen with addresses, telephone numbers, vehicle listing and defense line. The GML download of the geodata via WFS is possible here. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Fire fighting equipment stores district of Mittelsachsen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Katastrophenschutz, Rettung, Unfall, Leitstelle, Feuerwehrgerätehäuser, Ordnung. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2022-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
